notes: *the same* is the ASV's rendering of the emphatic הוּא (rule 18), the name being written in the clause; headed on *same*, which carries the identifying force.
Both לְ before Judah and Jerusalem are unrepresented, the ASV writing *commanded Judah and Jerusalem* with bare objects (rule 40).
קָטַר hiphil → *burn incense* heads on *incense* under rule 44, the supplied noun carrying the lexeme; לִפְנֵי fuses to *before*, headed on the construct noun.
